cases.summary: Real ovis-terminal serve runs a shell as t1; an interact viewer types go and the program prints ab then a 3-chunk Kitty f=100 PNG declaring c=4,r=2 (raw offset 4, 145 bytes) and three line feeds before images-done; the viewer receives the sequence byte-identical. terminal.screen with include_images true returns lines unchanged (row 1 is ab, the covered cells stay blank text) plus exactly one placeholder {image_id 4, format kitty, row 1, col 2, rows 2, cols 4, bytes 145} whose id is the image store key; the same read without include_images carries no images field.

cases.summary: --inject {"read":{"include_images":"yes"}}: after the same image is drawn, terminal.screen with include_images "yes", 1 or null is invalid_params at params.include_images (a JSON boolean is required), no result is returned, and the connection keeps serving: the next read with include_images true returns the one placeholder.
